independent_review.finding: navigator.share was selected when navigator.canShare was absent, so text-only Web Share could omit the PNG instead of using download fallback
independent_review.resolution_commit: a944c45 fix: require file share capability for kline

rereview.fallbackBranches: canShare absent and canShare false both call no share and trigger one download

objective: Expose the Android-equivalent local K-line screenshot action without external publication or backend writes.

android_evidence.fact: Android image_share/image_share1 capture the current activity with ScreenShotUtils and open the bitmap share dialog.

implementation: The capture target is the visible contract page container.
html2canvas is loaded only after the user requests a screenshot.
foreignObjectRendering avoids html2canvas 1.4.1 failing on Tailwind oklch() colors.
Web Share receives a PNG File only when navigator.canShare positively confirms file support; otherwise an object URL triggers a local PNG download.
The object URL is revoked after the download is started.
User cancellation is handled as a non-error and the action is re-enabled.

visual_evidence.result: Final 390x844 generated image is nonblank and contains the contract title, live price, horizontally scrollable period controls, K-line, volume, MA/MACD panes, visible order-book rows and bottom order actions. The header keeps favorite/share/fullscreen actions visible without overlap; only expected viewport/overflow clipping is present.

boundaries: No share target was selected and no content was externally published.
No backend API, WebSocket contract, authentication flow, order, or funds action changed.
The automated path forced local download into the isolated evidence directory.

scoped_eslint.finding: four no-explicit-any errors at current lines 340-343 predate both share commits; git blame ea298581 (2025-08-08)

certification_boundary: The capability-detection AMEND has bounded independent APPROVE. Real-device Web Share, the system share sheet and transient user-activation remain device-gated; no external publication or production claim.
